notes: kcal and protein (grams) per ONE catalog unit of each ingredient (the catalog’s "unit"; "basis" says exactly what one unit is). Generic foods use USDA FoodData Central SR Legacy reference values (fdc.nal.usda.gov; NDB numbers cited where known) converted to the catalog unit; branded/packaged items use typical package labels. Lean meats (chicken, 93/7 turkey, pork chops/loin) use raw values. Ground beef, ground pork, Italian sausage and bacon are counted AS EATEN per pound bought (USDA cooked value × cooking yield), because the recipes spoon off or drain the rendered fat. Oil, butter, mayo and dressings count in full at recipe amounts. Canned vegetables and beans are per can as eaten (drained where the recipe drains). Values are estimates for planning — a kind guide, not a lab number.
